items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: ( ?)Orlando Robeson(?) was with us on that show.

ctx.x: No. We didn't make Mississippi. We jumped all the way to Seattle, Washington, and played all the way back through Oregon, Utah, Colorado, and I think we made Kansas... I think we missed Missouri and made Kansas, and we played Iowa, and then we come on up through Michigan...yeah...and ended up way up yonder in Bangor, Maine, and come back down, and went down to Maryland, and that's when we closed it. ( ?)Orlando Robeson(?) was with us on that show.
And the band at this stage consisted of you and Snub...
